name: Metrics
description: This folder contains metric based dashboards for HAProxy

children.name: HAProxy - Backend Metrics
children.description: The HAProxy - Backend Metrics dashboard provides an at-a-glance view of HAProxy Backend HTTP codes, session, queue and network.
children.title: HAProxy - Backend Metrics

queries.queryString: proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_active_servers type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}} | sum by metric

panels.title: Backend Weight

queries.queryString: proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_weight type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}}

panels.description: The "weight" parameter is used to adjust the server's weight relative to other servers. All servers will receive a load proportional to their weight relative to the sum of all weights, so the higher the weight, the higher the load. The default weight is 1, and the maximal value is 256

queries.queryString: proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_http_response_* type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}} | parse field=metric haproxy_http_response_* as code | avg by proxy_cluster,host, proxy, code

panels.title: Response Errors

queries.queryString: proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_eresp type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}} | filter latest > 0

panels.description: Number of requests whose responses yielded an error

panels.title: Backend Connection Errors

queries.queryString: proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_econ type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}} | filter latest > 0

panels.description: Number of requests that encountered an error attempting to connect to a backend server

queries.queryString: proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_bin type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}} | sum by proxy_cluster,host,proxy
proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_bout type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}}| sum by proxy_cluster,host,proxy

panels.title: Availability - Redispatch/Retry Warnings

queries.queryString: proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_wredis type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}} | sum by proxy_cluster,host,proxy
proxy_cluster=* metric=haproxy_wretr type=backend proxy_cluster={{proxy_cluster}} host={{host}}  proxy={{proxy}} | sum by proxy_cluster,host,proxy

panels.description:
haproxy_wredis - Number of times a request was re-dispatched to a different backend	


haproxy_wretr - Number of times a connection was retried

panels.title: Unassigned Queued Requests
